title: MiniMax H3 - Video & Audio Generation
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for MiniMax H3: text/image/first-last-frame/reference-to-video with audio, lightx2v 8-step turbo LoRAs, TensorRT RIFE interpolation + upscaling, wildcard prompts and a Qwen3-VL enhancer. Models auto-download to your network volume on first boot.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download missing models to the attached network volume at worker boot. Requires a ≥160GB network volume attached to the endpoint — strongly recommended.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Max seconds a single generation job may run before the worker aborts it.

input.name: ComfyUI extra args
input.description: Extra launch flags for ComfyUI. Leave empty: --fast / --use-sage-attention / --async-offload corrupt int8-convrot stacks.

changelog:
## v1.1.11

- Removed `.runpod/tests.json`: the Hub health-check was pinned to a 24GB RTX 4090, which can never boot the ~100GB MMH3 stack; the Hub test now uses the endpoint GPU config (BLACKWELL_96)

## v1.1.9

- MiniMax H3-Image stills: T2I + Edit endpoints via ForgeHub with QwenVL enhancer presets
- Auto-provisioned DiT (int8 convrot) + VAE for H3-Image on worker volumes

## v1.1.6

- Updated MMH3 workflows: replaced turbo LoRA nodes with integrated turbo models
- Fixed model references: `Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_Pruned_v1.3_int8.safetensors` → `PRISM_DMAD_PDMD_int8.safetensors`, `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors` → `10Eros_Max_h3_8stepTURBO_beta7_fix1-native_int8_protected_edges_HQ.safetensors`
- Added LoRA style downloads to manifest: `h3-realism-people-t2v-i2v-r2v.safetensors` (realism) and `h3_character_swap.safetensors` (char_swap)
- Pulito manifest `models-manifest.txt`: rimosse sezioni commentate non più attive
- Aggiornamento manifest modelli per serverless Turbo stack

## v1.1.5

- Initial release
